Country geometry: Basemap countries_i intermediate political boundary; Caspian coastline: GSHHS intermediate; cross-checked against Natural Earth Azerbaijan reference geometry. Surrounding land: GSHHS intermediate-resolution coastpolygons via Basemap (basemap-data), WGS84; clipped to existing Azerbaijan map bounds. Approved target-country geometry, map projection and framing are unchanged. Inland water: GSHHS/GSHHG via Basemap resolution=i, WGS84.
